text:
Priya: Heads-up — Q2 capacity planning sync. Need decision on SKU mix (A100 vs H100) and whether we do a short 6mo lease for burst or push for a smaller buy commit. APAC needs extra headroom for May-July surge. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex: Quick numbers? what's the shortfall if we keep current commits + warm pool?
Priya: Rough sketch: projected peak request-rate +20% vs last Q. That translates to ~45k GPU-hours/week baseline, peak ~62k. Current committed capacity covers ~50k/week if all dedicated used. Warm pool adds ~6k/week in practice. Shortfall window = ~6-10k/week for 8-12 weeks.
Juan: For SKU tradeoffs: H100 gives ~1.8x throughput on our model mix but costs ~2x per-hour. A100 (80GB) is cheaper per-hour and more predictable on vendor lead times.
Leah: APAC latency/node availability: vendors are quoting long delivery for H100 in SG region (12-16 weeks). If we need burst in May, procurement leadtime kills buys. Renting short-term in-region or burst across eu/us with routing might be cleaner.
Chris: Can we simulate policy: route 30% of APAC traffic to eu for non-interactive flows? Might be acceptable for embeddings/batch. Not for low-latency chat.
Maya: Quick cost calc (very rough):
``` 
Option A: Lease H100 burst pool (3 months): $1.9M (cap ex as op-ex)
Option B: Buy smaller A100 commit + 6mo lease pockets: $1.4M + $0.45M lease = $1.85M
Option C: Buy heavy A100 commit (annual): $2.1M but lower unit cost long-run
```
Dan: Ops note: warm-pool hit rate for prefix cache is 22% in last surge; with Optimize changes we expect +8-10pp, that reduces GPU-hours by ~6-7k/week if rollout before peak. So software mitigations matter.
Priya: Good to include Optimize rollout in decision. If we can push rollout by Apr 15, it materially reduces buy requirements.
InfraBot: deploy:optimize v2 scheduled for 2026-04-12 to canary (25% of serving). See runbook: https://internal/runbooks/optimize-v2
Juan: Another angle: mix H100 for critical low-latency routes (canary sample) and A100 for bulk. If we reserve H100 only for 20% of traffic, we get most latency wins without doubling cost.
Leah: Risk: if H100 supply slips, that 20% fallback needs fallback model (quantized A100) — test matrix needed.
Maya: Finance note: FinanceBot, how do quarter commitments impact our burn and procurement approval timeline? :money_with_wings:
FinanceBot: Short answer: leases <= 6mo are approvable via standard CapEx/OpEx desk with 48h turnaround. Buys >$1M need procurement + legal + board notify (2-3 weeks). Also remind: annual commits require forecasting for GAAP/ASC treatment — will show as capex.
Priya: Proposal to exec: 1) Approve small buy of 40 A100 (annual) for baseline 2) Authorize 12-week burst lease of H100-equivalent capacity (or cross-region rentals) for surge window 3) Push Optimize v2 to canary now and full roll by Apr 15 4) Run fallback test matrix for quantized A100 -> deadline Apr 5
Chris: I'm +1 if we set a hard stop: if Optimize roll fails to reach 80% of expected reduction by Apr 10, cancel H100 lease and fallback to cross-region routing.
Juan: I'll draft SKU/RFP with vendors: include clause for partial deliveries and exchange to A100 if H100 supply misses. Vendors: MegaCloud, RackRent, EdgeBurst.
Maya: I'll queue cost comparison doc and a short slide for GTM (impact on published latency SLOs).
Priya: Thanks — next checkpoint Wed 2026-03-31 10:00 PT. Please add vendor quotes and test results before then. :+1:
Dan: noted, oncall will run stress tests on canary cluster tonight and post logs.
InfraBot: stress-test results uploaded: https://internal/logs/stress-2026-03-19 (summary: 18k rps sustained, tail latency 95p within SLO on A100 mix)
Priya: Great thread. If anyone has blockers for the Apr 5 test matrix reach out directly.
